name: Sweetcorn Rarebit Soup
desc: Welsh-rarebit flavour logic applied to a smooth sweetcorn soup.
method: Add sweetcorn, onion, garlic, stock and water.
Run Smooth.
Add Cheddar, milk, Worcestershire, mustard and black pepper.
Blend briefly until the cheese is incorporated.
science: Corn gives body and carotenoids; cheese provides protein and calcium.
note: Keep mustard subtle.

name: Mushroom, Marmite & Smoked Cheddar
desc: A deliberately British umami bomb: mushroom, Marmite, smoked Cheddar and garlic.
method: Add mushrooms, onion, garlic, stock and water.
Run Smooth.
Add Marmite, smoked Cheddar, cream and black pepper.
Blend briefly until glossy.
science: Mushrooms, yeast extract and mature cheese stack several sources of savouriness in one soup.
note: Do not add salt until the very end — Marmite, stock and cheese are already salty.

name: Apple, Bacon & Smoked Cheddar Cream
desc: Smoky bacon and Cheddar with just enough tart apple to lift the richness.
method: Add bacon, apple, onion, garlic, stock and water.
Run Smooth.
Add smoked Cheddar, cream and black pepper.
Blend briefly and taste.
science: This is primarily a flavour experiment rather than a ‘health soup’; the apple provides acidity and aroma against the smoked fat.
note: Use a tart apple and resist adding more — it should remain firmly savoury.

name: Carrot, Miso & Tahini Cream
desc: Carrot made much more savoury with white miso, sesame tahini and plenty of garlic.
method: Add carrots, onion, garlic, ginger, stock and water.
Run Smooth.
Add miso, tahini, chilli and black pepper.
Blend briefly until very smooth.
science: Carrots provide beta-carotene; tahini contributes sesame fats and some protein; miso keeps the profile savoury.
note: This should taste nutty and savoury rather than sweet.

name: Beetroot, Goat's Cheese & Caraway Cream
desc: Earthy beetroot, tangy goat's cheese and a restrained caraway note in a vivid purple soup.
method: Add beetroot, onion, garlic, caraway, stock and water.
Run Smooth.
Add goat's cheese and black pepper.
Blend briefly until completely incorporated.
science: Beetroot contributes folate and nitrate; goat's cheese adds protein, calcium and richness.
note: Use vacuum-packed plain cooked beetroot, not beetroot pickled in vinegar.

name: Leek, Pear & Stilton Cream
desc: A savoury leek soup with a small pear note and Stilton — cheese-board logic turned into soup.
method: Add leek, pear, onion, garlic, stock and water.
Run Smooth.
Add Stilton, cream and black pepper.
Blend briefly and taste.
science: The pear is here as an aromatic counterpoint to the blue cheese rather than as a sweetener.
note: This is intentionally not broccoli-and-blue-cheese; leek gives a cleaner, sweeter allium base.

name: Prawn, Mango & Chilli Coconut
desc: Sweet prawn and mango balanced by chilli, ginger, garlic and coconut — tropical but still savoury.
method: Add prawns, mango, onion, garlic, ginger, chilli, stock and water.
Run Smooth.
Add coconut milk and black pepper.
Blend briefly.
science: Prawns bring lean protein; mango provides carotenoids and vitamin C; coconut provides the creamy texture.
note: Keep mango to 150 g so this remains a savoury soup rather than a hot smoothie.

name: Smoked Haddock, Cauliflower & Curry Cream
desc: Kedgeree-adjacent flavours without rice: smoked haddock, curry spice and cauliflower in a silky cream.
method: Add haddock, cauliflower, onion, garlic, curry powder, turmeric, stock and water.
Run Smooth.
Add cream and black pepper.
Blend briefly until silky.
science: Haddock provides lean protein; cauliflower gives body and vitamin C without relying on potato.
note: Keep the curry spice modest — smoked fish should remain the main event.

name: Tomato, Dark Cocoa & Parmesan
desc: A dark savoury tomato soup where a tiny amount of cocoa deepens the roasted flavour rather than tasting chocolatey.
method: Add tomatoes, pepper, onion, garlic, purée, stock, water and paprika.
Run Smooth.
Add cocoa, Parmesan, cream and black pepper.
Blend briefly and taste.
science: The cocoa dose is culinary rather than nutritional; tomato and pepper supply carotenoids while Parmesan adds savoury depth.
note: Start with only 1 tsp cocoa. If you can clearly taste chocolate, there is too much.

name: Sweetcorn, Miso & Parmesan
desc: Sweetcorn's natural sweetness held in check by miso, Parmesan, black pepper and garlic.
method: Add sweetcorn, onion, garlic, stock and water.
Run Smooth.
Add miso, Parmesan, milk and black pepper.
Blend briefly until completely smooth.
science: Corn contributes carotenoids and fibre; miso and Parmesan provide complementary savoury flavours.
note: This is deliberately less cheesy than the Rarebit soup.

name: Roasted Pepper, Almond & Feta
desc: Romesco-adjacent flavours turned into a smooth soup: roasted pepper, almond, feta and smoked paprika.
ing: 30 g ground almonds or smooth almond butter
method: Add peppers, onion, garlic, almonds, stock, water and paprika.
Run Smooth.
Add feta and black pepper.
Blend briefly until silky.
science: Peppers supply vitamin C and carotenoids; almonds add unsaturated fat and feta contributes protein and calcium.
note: Jarred roasted peppers make this very practical with almost no waste.

name: Cauliflower, Hazelnut & Parmesan Cream
desc: Nutty hazelnut and Parmesan turn mild cauliflower into something much more luxurious.
ing: 30 g roasted unsalted hazelnuts or 25 g hazelnut butter
method: Add cauliflower, onion, garlic, hazelnuts, stock and water.
Run Smooth.
Add Parmesan, cream and black pepper.
Blend briefly until very smooth.
science: Hazelnuts add unsaturated fat and vitamin E; cauliflower contributes vitamin C and fibre.
note: Use unsalted hazelnuts. Hazelnut butter gives the smoothest result.

name: Mushroom, Soy & Sesame Black-Pepper Cream
desc: Mushroom soup shifted towards East Asia with soy, sesame and a serious black-pepper finish.
method: Add mushrooms, onion, garlic, ginger, stock and water.
Run Smooth.
Add soy, sesame oil, cream and black pepper.
Blend briefly until glossy.
science: Mushroom and soy provide a strong savoury base while sesame adds aroma and fat.
note: Sesame oil is powerful; 1 tsp is enough for the whole machine.

name: Mushroom, Miso & Smoked Cheddar Cream
desc: Mushroom umami stacked with miso and smoky cheese — excessive on paper, excellent in practice.
method: Add 300 g chestnut mushrooms, ½ onion, 4 garlic cloves, 1 vegetable stock cube and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 18 g white miso, 60 g smoked cheddar, 50 ml double cream, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Mushroom, miso and mature cheese provide complementary savoury compounds.
note: Taste before salting.

name: Pea, Crab & Smoked Bacon Cream
desc: Pea-and-bacon comfort with a sweet shellfish layer underneath.
method: Add 280 g frozen peas, 140 g crab meat, 70 g cooked smoked bacon, ½ onion, 3 garlic cloves, 1 stock cube and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 60 ml double cream, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Crab and bacon provide complete protein while peas add fibre and plant protein.
note: Strange sounding, but the three main flavours all work naturally with cream.

name: Tomato, Chorizo, Mascarpone & Cocoa
desc: Smoky tomato and chorizo with mascarpone and just enough cocoa to darken the flavour.
method: Add 90 g ready-to-eat chorizo, 380 g chopped tomatoes, 150 g roasted red pepper, ½ onion, 4 garlic cloves, ½ tsp smoked paprika and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 60 g mascarpone, 1 tsp unsweetened cocoa powder, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: The cocoa dose is culinary rather than medicinal; tomato and pepper supply carotenoids.
note: If the finished soup tastes of chocolate, reduce the cocoa next time.

name: Roasted Pepper, Mushroom & Gruyère
desc: Earthy mushroom, sweet roasted pepper and nutty Gruyère in one dense savoury soup.
method: Add 220 g chestnut mushrooms, 260 g roasted red pepper, ½ onion, 4 garlic cloves, 1 vegetable stock cube and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 55 g gruyère, 50 ml double cream, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Mushrooms add umami while peppers contribute vitamin C and carotenoids.
note: Keep tomato out: the point is pepper + mushroom + Gruyère.

name: Mushroom, Stilton & Walnut Cream
desc: A blue-cheese wildcard that avoids the broccoli pairing you don't fancy.
method: Add 280 g chestnut mushrooms, ½ onion, 4 garlic cloves, 1 vegetable stock cube, 390 ml water and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 50 g stilton, 50 ml double cream, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Walnuts provide unsaturated fats while Stilton and mushroom give a very deep savoury profile.
note: Stilton should be obvious but not overwhelming.

name: Tomato, Orange & Fennel Mascarpone
desc: Rich tomato with fennel, a little orange zest and mascarpone — aromatic, not sweet.
ing: ½ tsp finely grated orange zest
method: Add 400 g chopped tomatoes, 130 g fennel, ½ onion, 4 garlic cloves, 1 vegetable stock cube, 190 ml water and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 60 g mascarpone, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Tomato provides carotenoids; fennel and orange zest add volatile aromatics rather than meaningful sweetness.
note: Use zest, not orange juice.

name: Sweetcorn, Crab & Sage Parmesan
desc: Sweetcorn and crab made autumnal with sage, Parmesan and black pepper.
method: Add 180 g crab meat, 240 g sweetcorn, ½ onion, 3 garlic cloves, ¼ tsp dried sage, 1 fish or vegetable stock cube and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 25 g parmesan, 50 ml double cream, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Crab contributes protein and B12; sweetcorn adds carotenoids.
note: Sage is deliberately tiny — enough to shift the character without masking the crab.
